gloss: to repeat a grade; to overlap; to duplicate

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: ダブっていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to repeat a grade; to be held back
definitions.explanation: To fail to advance to the next school year and have to repeat the same grade.

definitions.gloss: to overlap; to duplicate; to double up
definitions.explanation: For things to be duplicated or for schedules to conflict.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ダブった。
examples.english: I had to repeat a year in college.
At this rate, I might have to repeat the year.

examples.japanese: ダブらないよう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{頑張|がんば}る→頑張る：01222_ganbaru⟧。
examples.english: I'll work hard so I don't have to repeat.

examples.japanese: ⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ダブって⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
⟦カード→カード：03836_kaado⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ダブった。
⟦{同|おな}じ→同じ：02857_onaji⟧{本|ほん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ダブって⟦{買|か}って→買う：00489_kau⟧しまった。
examples.english: I accidentally bought the same book twice.

notes:
ダブる comes from English 'double,' with る added to form a Japanese verb. A casual/colloquial word.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ダブる: to repeat a year; to overlap
- ダブり: duplication, duplicate (noun form)
- ⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ダブる: schedules conflict
- ダブって⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧: to accidentally buy a duplicate

FORMAL ALTERNATIVES:
- Sense 1 (repeat a grade): ⟦{留年|りゅうねん}→留年：05141_ryuunen⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧
- Sense 2 (overlap): ⟦{重複|ちょうふく}する→重複する：26812_choufukusuru⟧, ⟦{重|かさ}なる→重なる：02038_kasanaru⟧

ASPECT (ている):
ダブって⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ indicates a current state of overlapping or conflicting: ⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ダブって⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ (schedules are conflicting).

REGISTER:
Casual. Not appropriate for formal writing or business contexts. Use the formal alternatives listed above in those situations.
